description: This file defines mock classes for testing the IControl and IControlFactory interfaces within the firebolt::rialto namespace. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for control creation and client registration, facilitating unit testing of components that depend on these interfaces.

classes.name: ControlFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IControlFactory interface, used to simulate control object creation in tests.

classes.name: ControlMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IControl interface, used to simulate client registration in tests.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Mock method to simulate creation of an IControl instance.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Mock method to simulate registration of a control client.
